title: Why Saito hunted Atsu's family in Ghost of Yotei
subject: atsu
description:
Does Saito's reason change anything for you? 👇

The motive behind the massacre of Atsu's family, and the twin parallel most players miss. Spoilers for Ghost of Yotei.

scenes.text: The man who destroyed Atsu's family believed he was the victim.
Lord Saito was a warlord in Ezo, and Atsu's father Kengo was once his blacksmith.
During a famine, Saito became convinced that Kengo had turned his people against him.
So he sent the Yotei Six to make an example of them.
But that's not the darkest part. Two of the six were Saito's own twin sons, the Spider and the Dragon.
Atsu and Jubei were twins too. A father sent his twins to erase another family's twins.
Saito never saw himself as the monster. To the very end,
